Use case: stylized-concept. Project: Steal a Treasure / CRYSTAL CAVE second island, treasure ONE cracked round geode with purple interior. Match the supplied Meadow style reference ONLY: chunky Roblox voxel diorama, broad square stone blocks, crisp flat materials, playful toy proportions, clear daylight/cool violet crystal accents, cyan exit, thick tapered floating rock underside, distant floating spire islands. No hiding spots, no small foliage clutter, no realistic textures, no lava, no compulsory parkour. All playable land connected; broad walking ramps, substantial rock mountains, optional choke with two real flanks, three independent exits into cyan safety. 4-8 players. Concept art, not screenshot proof.
Layout: LANTERN CRESCENT. 384x384 crescent-shaped solid island, enormous curved cave mountain along north and west, split roof with daylight skylights, treasure on north +36 terrace. Central broad sunken amphitheatre floor -8. Three routes: west 18-wide two-ended roofed tunnel through the thick rock crescent (three skylights), centre 18-wide exposed winding bowl descent, east 18-wide elevated +20 crescent shelf. Two crosslinks at north fork and south court. Cyan exit south at Y0 with independent west/north/east entrances. ONE mechanic: crystals pulse between bright and dim in the west tunnel; always-visible ground seams, players and threat tells. Darkness is never concealment or immunity. Guardian LUX, a squat square basalt owl with violet brow prisms and cream face, wing-like slab arms; one guardian by geode. No bridges, no carts.
Asset type: TOP-DOWN BLUEPRINT, exact orthographic overhead with roof lifted/cut away to reveal tunnel. Flat clean dark navy drafting page, legible chunky voxel land forms and cliff contour bands. North at top. Orange centre shortcut line, green main line, blue tunnel line, violet crosslinks, bright cyan safety footprint south. Distinct labelled T geode and P portal and two I junctions. Label heights, footprint and route names only; no invented timings. Tunnel dashed outline plus explicit entry/exit/skylight marks. Include title 'A / LANTERN CRESCENT' and tiny legend 'GREEN MAIN / ORANGE SHORTCUT / BLUE TUNNEL'. Not a perspective view. Illustrative planning geometry.

Layout: FRACTURE CATHEDRAL. 384x384 roughly triangular connected island with TWO colossal thick jagged rock towers, west treasure tower +40 (one geode), east secondary spire +28. Huge split geode crown frames skyline. A transverse shallow fissure floor -8 divides tall north massif and southern basin. THREE routes: broad west +8 rock causeway main, exposed OPTIONAL 18-wide pale violet crystal bridge at +8 over fissure, east 18-wide TWO-ENDED skylit tunnel cut through thick secondary spire, two broad crosslinks north and south of fissure. Cyan portal south Y0 with three separate approaches. ONE mechanic: optional bridge cracks after someone steps on it, bright pink cracks announce 2.5 seconds before three broad panels crumble; 12 second recovery, continuous dry shallow floor and two walking recovery ramps below. Show mostly intact bridge with ONE visibly cracked panel. No darkness mechanic, no cart. Guardian FACET, broad squat basalt tortoise biped, heavy geode shell, purple polygon crown and giant square mittens; one guardian beside geode.

Layout: SWITCHYARD MESA. 448x320 long asymmetric diagonal island. Massive tall mining mesa occupies northeast with treasure +32 inside OPEN geode mouth, stepped rock buttresses and second southwest hill +20; broad dry central quarry floor -8, thick tapered underside. THREE routes northeast treasure to southwest cyan portal: north winding 18-wide terraced causeway, south 18-wide two-ended skylit tunnel through mesa then quarry rim, central OPTIONAL mine-cart rail swoop around broad quarry. One short two-seat chunky wooden minecart at upper loading dock, wide parallel walk bypass. Two broad crosslinks between routes at quarry entrance and exit. ONE mechanic: scheduled cart shuttle shortcut; fixed tracks, mount/dismount only at level docks, no extra abilities. Guardian BORAX, squat stone pangolin miner with quartz helmet crest, broad rectangular tail and violet segmented shoulders; one guardian by geode. No shattering bridges and no dynamic darkness.
